name: 氨基酸温和不紧绷洁面乳款
description: 氨基酸表活温和清洁、绵密泡沫、洗后不紧绷

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft blush-beige #F6EFEA for info and scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC and neutral matte board #EFE9E1
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the product across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean gentle skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, soft blush-beige #F6EFEA, charcoal text #33383D and one teal accent #7FA7A0; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif;  consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle standing upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒说清温和清洁的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, product on the left
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the left, occupying 50-60%. Background soft blush-beige #F6EFEA, soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented efficacy claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.displayName: 皂基洁面紧绷泛红痛点
shots.intent: 放大紧绷、泛红、越洗越干的痛点
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel harsh and drying; right panel soft and gentle
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical camera and framing. Left panel: an abstract patch of tight, dull, irritated skin under harsh flat light, conveying post-cleanse tightness without showing a real face. Right panel: {product} in soft gentle light conveying comfort. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background soft blush-beige #F6EFEA on both panels, soft top light. Each panel carries. The product occupies 50-60% per panel. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated claims or statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入真实使用场景，营造清爽舒适
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level, candid handheld feel over a bathroom counter
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle mist, soft contact shadow
shots.background: matte light-stone bathroom counter #E7E2DC with soft mist
shots.props: a folded towel and a small tray, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} resting on a matte light-stone bathroom counter #E7E2DC with a soft morning mist around it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle mist, soft contact shadow. Props: a folded towel and a small tray, not covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no messy clutter.

shots.intent: 用细腻泡沫证明温和亲肤
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing fine foam texture
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of dense fine foam pumped from {product}, tight zoom on the foam surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing fine foam texture. Neutral matte board background #EFE9E1. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Negative: no blurry subject, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 讲清成分与容量，消除规格疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay, top-down 90-degree, product upright in frame
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: a few empty rounded label areas as info placeholders
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic layout for {product}, flat lay shot from a top-down 90-degree angle with the product upright. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background soft blush-beige #F6EFEA. The product occupies 60-70%. Negative: no tiny unreadable text, no fabricated ingredient claims, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.displayName: 敏感肌温和无添加信任
shots.intent: 降风险，强调温和无添加
shots.camera: clean 3/4 product angle beside a badge area
shots.props: one empty seal-shaped badge area as a proof placeholder
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background pure white #FFFFFF, even clean studio light. The product occupies 50-60%. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data; no fabricated badges, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 收口促单，突出组合与优惠
shots.camera: group 3/4 shot, product with a second unit beside it to suggest a set
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, soft contact shadows
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light with soft contact shadows. Background soft blush-beige #F6EFEA. The group occupies 55-60% overall. Negative: no real discount numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no invented claims.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张爆款洁面乳套图提炼；已剥离原品牌字、模特与原文案，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
